howto.what: Claude 的每次读取、编辑和命令操作都会被压缩成观察记录，会话结束时汇总。相关的记录会自动注入以后的提示，让下次会话带着上次的上下文开始。
howto.when: 从你在同一项目的第二次会话起，会开始注入记忆。首次会话先建立记忆，之后的会话自动注入相关上下文；也可输入 /learn-codebase 主动全量加载。

say.note: 你会得到对工作流程的说明。

say.text: 它什么时候会注入记忆？

say.note: 你会了解本地存储位置。

howto.what_en: Every Read, Edit, and Bash that Claude makes is turned into a compressed observation. Observations are summarized at session end, and relevant ones are auto-injected into future prompts, so the next session starts with context from the last one.
howto.when_en: Memory injection starts on your second session in a project. The first session seeds memory; subsequent sessions receive auto-injected context for relevant past work. You can also run /learn-codebase to load the whole repo in one pass.

say_en.note: You'll get an explanation of the process.
You'll find out about local storage.
